title: fix(console): View all → New seeds the relationship lookup's dependsOn fields
body:
Fixes #37290
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：从记录页相关列表点「查看全部」进入列表，再点「新建」时，关联字段所依赖的上级值（如客户）会和父记录一起预填，不再卡在「请先选择客户」。
- 为什么做：补齐上一张相关页签预填改动漏掉的「查看全部」入口，两条入口用同一套预填规则。
- 出错会怎样：只影响新建表单打开时的初始值；关联字段没有声明依赖时行为与今天一致，读不到父记录时退回只带父记录；可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`ObjectDataPage`'s New under a record trail (a related list's "View all") wrote the parent `formLink` pair alone. It now applies `relatedCreateSeedOf` (from `@object-ui/plugin-detail/core`, already exported and already imported by `RelatedRecordActionsBridge`): parent pair first, then one `formLink` pair per `dependsOn` field, the same URL shape the related tab's New writes.

- A2 measured: the page holds only the trail's parent id (`source.i`), not the parent record. The related-tab New uses its mounted parent record; here the page reads it once via `dataSource.findOne(source.o, source.i)`, and only when the relationship lookup declares a non-empty `dependsOn` (looked up with `parentRelationshipFieldDef`, so array-form field lists count too). No `dependsOn` means no read. A failed or empty read opens with the parent pair alone.
- A1 holds: no export change; nothing copied.

Files to read first (by risk): `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.tsx` (the New button's `onClick`, the async `findOne` branch).

## Tests

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.viewAllNewSeed-37290.test.tsx`: two cases.
- `contract.opportunity` `dependsOn: ['account']`, trail parent `opportunity O-1` (account `A-1`): `formLink` = `['opportunity:O-1', 'account:A-1']`, `findOne` called once with `('opportunity', 'O-1')`.
- CONTROL: `task.opportunity` with no `dependsOn`: `formLink` = `['opportunity:O-1']`, no read of the parent.

<details><summary>Pin green with fix, red without (head ad4ceb5764)</summary>

- With the fix: `Test Files 1 passed (1) · Tests 2 passed (2)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `ObjectDataPage.tsx` checked out from base `ff6f9768d2` (`relatedCreateSeedOf` count 0), restored from `HEAD` (hash matches the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty): `Tests 1 failed | 1 passed (2)`, `AssertionError: expected [ 'opportunity:O-1' ] to deeply equal [ 'opportunity:O-1', 'account:A-1' ]`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 1`. The control stays green both ways.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- "That path seeds through the same `relatedCreateSeedOf`": yes, the one exported function, no copy.
- "One pin covers it, red without the fix": the file above, red reading quoted.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gates</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 38 derived, 36 run (all exit 0), 2 NOT-MEASURED (`check:type-check-debt` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: both need the shared verify lock, held by a sibling run 30+ minutes). CI runs both.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: NOT MEASURED locally for the same reason; CI `Type Check UI` covers it.
- `overlap-check --branch=HEAD`: `VERDICT clean exit 0`. origin/main merged once before opening (no conflict).
</details>

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.viewAllNewSeed-37290.test.tsx`; expect 2 passed.
